descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S03 Encryption evidence attached to the UAT result

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Encryption evidence (the Convex at-rest setting and a network check) is attached to the UAT result. (TFA-92568 AC 14; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U3 Convex at-rest encryption is confirmed active on the account through a settings check. At-rest encryption is confirmed active. (UAT OAT-02; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given S01, S02 and S19 done on the same build

When Attach the evidence to the OAT-02 result (location per Q8)

Then The result carries: (a) the Convex at-rest evidence (S02); (b) the network check, i.e. a HAR summary of hosts, schemes and counts per mode from S01 plus the native capture from S19; (c) the 3.1 record (main commit, deployment, date, note model ID, Bedrock guardrail ID and version, PR #46 in the build yes/no) and, per step, the speech-to-text engine and the …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92568 AC 14 and Eng 3 ('Convex at-rest setting and a network check'), plus ground rules 3.1 and 3.9. Both kinds of evidence must be present, dated, and must name the build they were taken on. Either one missing, or any 3.1 / 3.9 field missing, = Fail.

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method DOC · Document check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: DOC · Document check; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: code-review.
